podcast.body: The Replacements recorded this song to celebrate the "quirky music heard on low-frequency FM stations." This music, known as "Left of the Dial Rock," was largely considered uncommercial until the late 1980s. "the replacements who recorded an actual song called Left of the Dial, to celebrate the quirky music heard on low-frequency FM stations."
